---
title: "Assignments"
---

Each group of about six produces **two products** over the course: a **research proposal** on its own question (built in Sessions 1–7, presented in Session 8) and a **draft manuscript** from the FLUID-ICU course dataset (analysed in Sessions 5–6, written in Sessions 7–8, peer reviewed after the course). The marks are formative: they help groups improve.

| | What it is | Download |
|:----------------|:----------------------------------------|:--------------|
| **[Proposal brief](proposal-brief.qmd)** | What to produce for the proposal, part by part, with roles and deadlines | [Word](files/assignments/Proposal_Brief.docx) · [PDF](files/assignments/Proposal_Brief.pdf) |
| **[Presentation guide](presentation-guide.qmd)** | The six slides, timekeeping and the feedback format for Session 8 | [Word](files/assignments/Presentation_Guide.docx) · [PDF](files/assignments/Presentation_Guide.pdf) |
| **[Proposal rubric](proposal-rubric.qmd)** | How the written proposal and the presentation are scored (100 points) | [Word](files/assignments/Proposal_Rubric.docx) · [PDF](files/assignments/Proposal_Rubric.pdf) |
| **[Manuscript brief](manuscript-brief.qmd)** | The FLUID-ICU manuscript: the five questions, what to write and when, rules | [Word](files/assignments/Manuscript_Brief.docx) · [PDF](files/assignments/Manuscript_Brief.pdf) |
| **[Manuscript rubric](manuscript-rubric.qmd)** | How the manuscript and the peer review are scored (100 points) | [Word](files/assignments/Manuscript_Rubric.docx) · [PDF](files/assignments/Manuscript_Rubric.pdf) |
| **[Peer-review instructions](peer-review.qmd)** | The peer-review swap after Session 8: how to review and how to respond | [Word](files/assignments/Peer_Review_Instructions.docx) · [PDF](files/assignments/Peer_Review_Instructions.pdf) |

## Timeline

- **Proposal:** Part 1 in Sessions 1–2, Part 2 in Sessions 3–4, Part 3 in Sessions 5–6, Part 4 in Session 7, presentation in Session 8.
- **Manuscript:** question assigned and Table 1 understood in Session 5, results interpreted in Session 6, Methods and Results drafted in Session 7, complete draft in Session 8, then the peer-review swap and response letter within 2 weeks after Session 8.

The Word templates are on the [Templates](templates.qmd) page.
